$comment: NEW-77: the VoiceWave rings (catalog/style.json `voiceWave`). Inputs hand-written (size = the root recipe's px edge, activity, level, bands, elapsed seconds, reducedMotion); `expected` = src/voice-wave.ts voiceWave: per ring (outer, mid, inner) its steps + 1 points in px from the box's top-left, rounded to 0.01, its fill/stroke alpha and stroke width; the child's edge (0 = not painted); the phase. The Rust core (`voice_wave`) and every painter replay it; a painter's drawn path stays within 0.5 px of these points.

cases.name: lg listening with bands at 1.5 s
xl thinking ignores level and bands
xl listening under reduced motion keeps phase 0
md: a 24 px icon scales down to the 16.8 px child box
lg: a 24 px icon stays at its size (never scaled up)
xl: a wide text child scales by its longer edge
sm: the child is kept but not painted
an unknown activity falls back to idle
